main.summary: Provides the effective local and signing identities for an object.

method.name: TryGetLocalIdentity
method.summary: Attempt to get the effective local identity an object.
method.returns: True when the local identity is available; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetSigningIdentity
method.summary: Attempt to get the effective signing identity an object.
method.returns: True when the signing identity is available; otherwise false.
